opening.argument: The presentation promotes a paid, recruitment-based matrix rather than a conventional business opportunity. Participation begins with a ten-dollar BUSD contribution and an additional smart-chain wallet amount, while payment depends on having “three people under you in each of these levels.” The speaker then describes recruits generating payments, with the last recruit’s payment used by the upline to reopen the board. Continued receipt of funds is tied to upgrading, and first-cycle proceeds are expected to fund the next level. Viewers are directed to register through a Trust Wallet link, join the speaker’s team, and are told they will “make massive money.” These features establish an upfront-funded, tiered recruitment structure presented as a lucrative opportunity.
